title: database.branch_created
description: A branch of a database was made. `node_id` of the entry is the source database; `node.created` is written for the branch node. Names, IDs and counts only: never a row value, a parameter or an engine message (decision 0004-8). This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `database.branch_created`. Step 2, planned (decision 0004-21).

constraints_left_out.description: Masked copy: constraints that could not be built again (pseudonym collisions); their names are in the branch status.
